page.layout: One page of text: running head at the top, page number at its left. Below it, a faint mirrored text block (show-through from the other side, not transcribed), then a centred heading in larger type. No notes, no catchword, no signature.
page.notes: The faint text in the upper half of the page is show-through from the reverse side and is not transcribed. The heading reads "Inferatur" in print, with the long s printed as f; it is transcribed here as "Inseratur" with a plain s, per the long-s rule. The printed form may be read as "Inferatur" if the original spelling is required. The right and left margins carry no legible printed text.
